name: 18101 · Allentown, PA
findings: ZIP 18101 (Allentown) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18101 (Allentown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18101 (Allentown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
